forbiddenInformation: opponent private hand before public reveal
deck order or unrevealed deck contents
physical game RNG or shuffle seed
raw Twinleaf engine state outside the validated actor projection
other role process memory or private files
observationBoundary.caveat: The policy module is actor-view-only by code review and protocol fixture tests, but the existing worker runs in the same Node process as the runner and is not a security sandbox. These tests do not prove process isolation.

determinism.repeatedRequestInvariant: same request/config/seat yields the same decision
determinism.physicalSeedAccess: not present in the policy API; a seed field in the actor observation is rejected by the actual request validator

roleAndSeat.testCoverage: synthetic actor fixtures exercise both seat 0 and seat 1; no game-level seat coverage

decisionBoundary.unsupportedPromptBehavior: abstain with a stable reason code; no delegated decoder or native fallback
decisionBoundary.rootFallback: select pass only when an actual pass token exists in the action frontier; otherwise abstain
decisionBoundary.selectionValidation: the actual Agent49 validateDecision function enforces prompt choice tokens, uniqueness, selection bounds, cancel/empty-selection semantics

runtime.localHarness: local V8 isolate evaluated the actual repository worker validator source, policy module source and test file; node:test/node:assert were supplied by a deterministic registration/assertion shim

sharedConstraints.testSplit: development fixtures only; held-out review cases are separately listed and unexecuted
